notes:
- Album Info: Y on an album → Edit Album Info fills in its tags from MusicBrainz, iTunes, Deezer, Wikipedia or by hand (by Emanuele Macrì)
- Settings → Library → Missing Info lists the albums without an artist or track numbers
- Saving writes only the fields you changed, and asks first
- Clear Now Playing; up/right raise the volume on Now Playing (0.47)
